title: LSTM state carried, 10 s chunks, gradients clipped
description: Carried LSTM state trained on 10 s chunks: the learning signal runs back through the last 10 s, so the network can be taught to use EMG history up to 10 s old (the 500 ms and 1 s chunk settings only teach the last 0.5 or 1 s). Tests whether torque depends on what happened more than 1 s earlier; compare with the reference and with the plain 10 s window (WL5_10s) on matched seeds. Two training changes come with the long chunks: gradients are clipped to norm 1 (long chunks can make them blow up), and the epoch limit is 400 (fast400 protocol: learning rate × 0.5 after 6 flat epochs, early stop 15), because 10 s chunks give only about 7 weight updates per epoch. The 8 session-1 trials train side by side (one batch lane each); the state starts at zero at the start of every trial and epoch. Everything else as the reference: active torque (each session's own relaxed-hold passive torque subtracted), EMG ÷ session-1 maximum, plain mean-squared error, LSTM 16 units × 2 layers, dropout 0.0, learning rate 0.01, causal envelope (2nd-order 2 Hz low-pass), first and last 1 s of every trial cut, trained on session 1 and tested on session 2.
